subject.title: improve: warn before non-ClawHub plugin installs

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new fail-closed non-ClawHub install acknowledgement requirement across setup, repair, update, and channel workflows once the CLI docs are complete?
rationale: The PR changes existing noninteractive install and repair behavior in security-sensitive flows, so automation cannot decide whether the compatibility break is an acceptable product/security tradeoff.

options.title: Accept after docs are complete
options.body: Update the CLI references for the new flag and then land the fail-closed behavior as an intentional security hardening.

options.title: Preserve compatibility by default
options.body: Keep existing scripted repair/setup behavior working by default and introduce the stricter acknowledgement as an explicit opt-in path.

options.title: Wait for ClawHub trust rollout
options.body: Pause this PR until the ClawHub dependency-scanning/trust-metadata step is confirmed ready, matching the PR body merge-order note.

recommendation.title: Accept after docs are complete
recommendation.body: Update the CLI references for the new flag and then land the fail-closed behavior as an intentional security hardening.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current PR and the related ClawHub trust implementation being extended here.
